paperwren.description: Paperwren is a lightweight document reader and PDF toolkit that brings all your files together in one app. Open PDFs, Word documents, spreadsheets, presentations, eBooks, comics and more, even when files have missing or incorrect extensions. Highlight text, add notes, fill and sign forms, scan documents, extract text with OCR, and organize or compress PDFs without relying on online services. Everything runs locally, with no ads, accounts or analytics, keeping your documents private and under your control.
